name: Grevillea Robusta
description: Fast-growing evergreen tree with fern-like leaves, excellent for boundaries and firewood

name: Senna Siamea
description: Medium-sized flowering tree, excellent for timber, firewood, and soil conservation

name: Neem Tree
description: Fast-growing evergreen with natural pest control abilities and medicinal properties

name: Blue Gum Tree
description: Fast-growing eucalyptus excellent for timber and reforestation

name: Lemon Tree
description: Citrus tree producing nutritious vitamin C-rich fruits

name: Acacia Tree
description: Hardy tree excellent for timber, firewood, and soil conservation

name: Ashoka Tree
description: Medium-sized evergreen with medicinal bark and leaves, culturally significant

name: Aquilaria
description: Evergreen tree used for flavoring curries, construction wood, and traditional medicine

name: Christmas Palm
description: Slender palm with bright red winter fruits, excellent for landscaping

name: Golden Palm
description: Multi-stemmed palm with golden-yellow fronds in full sun

name: Queen Palm
description: Medium-sized palm with attractive bamboo-looking trunk

name: Dieffenbachia Seguine
description: Also known as dumbcane or tuftroot, this plant has an exotic appeal with wonderfully shaped leaves featuring brush strokes of cream, yellow and white that enhance the leaf shape

name: Dracaena Fragrans
description: Also known as Corn plant, it's a slow-growing broadleaf evergreen shrub. Called corn plant because of the resemblance of its tall, unbranched stem to a corn stalk with palm-like habit

name: Drimiopsis
description: Drimiopsis produces interesting foliage with attractive speckled patterning and tends to grow in clumps. Foliage is oval-shaped and may be thin or fleshy, covered in fine hairs

name: Coleus
description: Coleus plants have square stems and leaves situated directly opposite one another. The foliage varies widely in shape, style, and color, with new patterns introduced regularly

name: Swiss Cheese Plant
description: Named for its huge leaves with holes that resemble Swiss cheese. Leaf shape changes as it matures from entire to having holes to eventually having perforations. An evergreen epiphytic vine that grows up to 13' tall

name: Gynura
description: This herbaceous evergreen is noted for its unusual velvety purple leaves and stems. Best displayed in a hanging basket, it produces tiny orange-yellow flowers in fall

name: Philodendron
description: Tree philodendron is a tropical plant with large, showy leaves grown as a houseplant in temperate climates. It can tolerate deep shade but prefers bright, indirect light and moist soil

name: Episcia Cupreata
description: Episcia Cupreata needs lots of bright, indirect light and well-drained potting soil. Produces solitary flowers that are usually red, pink, and orange

name: Begonia Peltatifolia
description: Begonia Peltatifolia is a tender perennial grown for their foliage and colorful flowers. Can be grown outdoors, indoors in pots, or in hanging baskets

name: Peperomia Argyreia
description: Fascinating fleshy leaves are banded with greens and greys that sway on central red-purple stems, giving it the alternative name of Watermelon Peperomia

name: Anthurium Crystallinum
description: Beautiful indoor plant perfect for home or office decoration

name: Heart of Jesus
description: Low-growing foliage plants that grow up to 25 inches tall with large arrow or heart-shaped decorative leaves up to 18 inches long. Leaves have a thin, papery texture

name: Alocasia
description: Alocasia, also known as elephant's ear, has large beautifully patterned leaves. Despite being sizeable, it looks airy and elegant thanks to tall, smooth stems growing from a tuber

name: Zebra Plant
description: The zebra plant is grown for its flower bracts and dark green leaves with prominent white colored veins. It's a fairly popular plant for both flowering and foliage appeal

name: Broadleaf Lady Palm
description: Native to China and Taiwan, this multi-stemmed palm has proven successful in removing airborne toxins including ammonia, formaldehyde, xylene, and carbon dioxide from indoor air

name: Aglaonema
description: Aglaonema belongs to the Araceae family and is commonly known as Chinese Evergreen. Low growers ranging from 8 inches to 4 feet in height with attractive foliage

name: Strelitzia Nicolai
description: Commonly known as wild banana or giant white bird of paradise, it's a species of banana-like plants with erect woody stems reaching 7-8m height, with clumps spreading up to 3.5m

name: Shame Plant
description: Mimosa pudica, or sensitive plant, is named for its unique characteristic of curling up when touched. The fernlike leaves curl inwards when disturbed, and it produces purple fuzzy flowers

name: Felt Bush
description: A succulent perennial growing 61-91cm tall with large fleshy leaves covered in fine velvety hairs. Produces clusters of small urn-shaped flowers ranging from reddish orange to greenish yellow

name: Bird of Paradise
description: Grows from rhizomes to 1-1.5 meters tall with stiff, erect, leathery leaves. Features stunning orange and blue flowers with two erect pointed petals and five stamens in a boat-shaped green bract with red borders

name: Painter's Palette
description: An herbaceous perennial growing to 18 inches tall that spreads by underground stems. Features large oval leaves 4-6 inches long with beautiful rich green, maroon lightning bolt markings, and cream patches

name: Baby Rubber Plant
description: Pepper Face is a tropical evergreen herbaceous shrub that grows up to 2' tall. Features glossy cupped, obovate leaves on branched stems with petioles usually tinged pink
